title: GBRG Graph Edge
description: A typed, weighted relationship between two SemanticCells. Orientation: `from` DEPENDS ON `to` (for a call B->A, from=B, to=A).

kind.description: Mapped to the graphdb edge label (CALLS, INHERITS, IMPORTS, TESTED_BY, CHURNS_WITH).

weight.$comment: graphdb properties are NODE-scoped, so weight CANNOT be a graphdb edge property. GBRG persists it in an explicit side map keyed by (from, to, label) — see gbrg-core::EdgeWeights and docs/ADR-001. It is carried here in the wire contract only.
